name: Kiro's Cosmic Haven
description: Space Capsule V8.0 — Single-Row Cosmic Dynamic Island HUD & Unobstructed 3D Sanctuary Viewport
changelog: V8.0: Re-architected Sanctuary top cockpit into a sleek single-row Cosmic Dynamic Island HUD (≤44px height). Consolidated Twin Sanctuary Beacon Pill, Sanctuary Economy tokens, and Comms Cluster into a unified horizontal row. Removed center stage floating pill in favor of tap-to-expand Bottom Sheet, giving 100% of the screen center to Kiro with generous 25% negative headroom.
